mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 800 & UNRATE < 6% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases over a 3-year period.
